title: Birthplace at Barracks and St. Claude, born 1901
summary: Barbarin locates his birth house on Barracks and St. Claude, still standing, gives 1901 as his birth year, and says few musicians lived nearby.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace
